programme.title: Time Pass

programme.title: The Murderer

programme.title: Badal
programme.desc: Badal witnesses his family being massacred during a riot in his village. He is raised by a terrorist and soon sets out to exact revenge on the police officer responsible for his family's murder.

programme.title: Happy Ending
programme.desc: Yudi is suffering from writer's block and his publishers decide to stop supporting him and instead publish the work of an Indian bestselling author. So, he must do something soon to maintain his fame.

programme.title: Parwana
programme.desc: Parwana spends his days brightening the lives of the downtrodden with a series of odd jobs. Just as Parwana falls in love and marries the girl of his dreams, a group of vicious criminals label him a traitor and Parwana is thrown behind bars. Despite the mafia's best attempts to permanently silent Parwana as he languishes in jail, the daring hero escapes and sets out on a mission to clear his name and expose the real criminals.
